mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, we are looking at 52 degrees with overcast skies near Fireman's Park. We are in the third quarter moon phase tonight, and please note that the ISS will be passing overhead, though it will unfortunately not be visible due to our current cloud cover. Looking toward the overnight hours, we will hit a low of 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.
Looking at our inbox and city reports, there are currently no new city news articles or official emails to share with residents this evening.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today you can find the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol, plus live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on November 2, and a variety of trivia nights starting November 4 at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.
The Verona Police Department did not provide an update for this week, so we have no specific incidents to report.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is Mint Explosion. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10:30 PM tonight.
